title: Bean Drain Input
description: What a drain starts from: every bean copy to read, the agents that may hold a bean and how each is recognised, what each owner already holds, the activity window, and where the queue is written. Skill skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/bean-drain.md, bean n7x7.

copies.description: EVERY copy of the bean store, not only the one this checkout mounts. While there is more than one, a claim is a plain commit on each.

ref.description: The branch holding the store, e.g. cat/cat-harness/beans, or main.

defs.description: Directory of bean files on that ref, e.g. beans/defs.

agents.description: Who may be draining, told apart by commit author on the bean branch. An author matching none of these is treated as another agent.

self.description: true for the agent running this drain; its own recent commits do not block it.

holdings.description: Owner (thread or agent name) to the bean ids it already holds, used to group new beans with the owner already working in that area. {} on a first run.

windowHours.description: A commit to a bean by another agent within this window means skip it.

queueFile.description: Where the queue is written for every drainer to read, e.g. drain-queue/open-beans-<date>.md in the shared project files.

repos.description: Repositories whose open PRs are searched for a bean id before a claim. Defaults to the repos of `copies`, plus every repo the drained beans' PRs land in.

beanId.description: A bean id, full (folio-assistant-f1e1) or short (f1e1).
